segments.title: Jambalaya program introduction and sound check
segments.summary: The interviewer introduces the Jambalaya program series and the microphone is tested.

segments.title: Ornette Coleman, Ed Blackwell and avant-garde in New Orleans
segments.summary: The interviewer lectures on Ornette Coleman's stay in New Orleans, Ed Blackwell's brass band drumming roots, and introduces Allen Toussaint and rhythm and blues.

segments.title: Family music and radio and records in childhood
segments.summary: Toussaint talks about his father's trumpet, his sister and brother playing, and how radio mattered more than scarce records.

segments.title: Learning piano and brief lessons
segments.summary: Toussaint cannot remember when he began piano, had only a couple of months of lessons, and the talk turns to old-timers' attitudes to reading music.

segments.title: Growing up in Gert Town
segments.summary: Toussaint names his neighborhood, Gert Town near Carrollton, and the interviewer explains its name and a record about it.

segments.title: Booker T. Washington High School band and classmates
segments.summary: Toussaint played in the beginners band at Booker T., left to tour with Shirley and Lee, and names schoolmates.
